name: Harbor Watch
title: Waykeepers of Saltmere
examine: A road soldier a long way from the road. The lamp badge is polished; the boots are salt-white.
lines: The lamp stays lit. Even at the end of the road.
Tier-three country past that gate. Go fed, go armed, go by day.
Trouble on the quay answers to the Portreeve. Trouble on the road answers to us.
